raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 13 (ingested 2026-01-18) sent txn_ts as DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS (e.g. '17/01/2026 06:02:01') instead of ISO format, so the TIMESTAMP cast fails. The rows can be parsed explicitly while all other rows stay on the existing ISO cast.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^\\d{2}/\\d{2}/\\d{4} ') THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^\\d{2}/\\d{2}/\\d{4} ') THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
